scope: All year/period or date/hour fields and eight weather-zone values plus published totals compared against independently addressed original source cells in complete 24 XLS/XLSX files. Historical sections remain distinct even where their column header says Forecast Year. Gross/net/PV, coincident/non-coincident, winter periods, source notes and provider scenarios remain separate. No totals are recomputed. Unit fields are populated only from explicit MW table titles. In rows(), actual download-title P90 labels enrich forecast rows before filtering; no filename-based percentile is invented for read(), and historical rows are never assigned a forecast percentile. Source counts retain overlapping vintages and are not unique observations.
